description: This file defines a class `UserManagementEventHooks` with static asynchronous methods that handle user-related events, such as user creation. It includes functions for creating audit logs, sending invitation emails, and other side effects related to user management within the litellm proxy system.

classes.name: UserManagementEventHooks
classes.description: A class providing static asynchronous methods to handle user creation events, email invitations, and audit logging within the litellm proxy system.

methods.description: Sends an email invitation to a new user, attempting to use enterprise email hooks if available, otherwise falling back to legacy email notification procedures.

methods.description: Sends a legacy version of the user invitation email, primarily used if enterprise email hooks are unavailable.
